plain: In place for now, until something permanent is set

webster.text: Provided for present need or for the occasion; temporarily established; temporary; as a provisional government or regulation; a provisional treaty.

example.quote: MORRIS objected also to the President of the Senate being provisional successor to the President, and suggested a designation of the Chief Justice.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, August 27, 1787
